import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static long mod_pow(long b, long e) {
        long res = 1;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) res = res * b % MOD;
            b = b * b % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        long[][] p = new long[6][6];
        long inv100 = mod_pow(100, MOD - 2);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                long x = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
                p[i][j] = (int)((x * inv100) % MOD);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = n; i <= 5; ++i) p[i][i] = 1;
        
        List<Integer> tri = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int m = 0; m < 64; ++m) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(m) == 3) {
                tri.add(m);
            }
        }
        
        long[] f = new long[1 << 20];
        long[] g = new long[1 << 20];
        
        // First part: columns 0-2
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); ++mask) {
            boolean[][] grid = new boolean[6][6];
            long prod = 1;
            int idx = 0;
            
            for (int r = 0; r < 6; ++r) {
                for (int c = 0; c <= 2; ++c) {
                    if ((mask >> idx & 1) == 1) {
                        grid[r][c] = true;
                        prod = prod * p[r][c] % MOD;
                    } else {
                        prod = prod * ((1 - p[r][c] + MOD) % MOD) % MOD;
                    }
                    ++idx;
                }
            }
            
            int comb_mask = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < tri.size(); ++i) {
                int combo = tri.get(i);
                int[] idxs = new int[3];
                int cnt = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) {
                    if ((combo >> k & 1) == 1) {
                        idxs[cnt++] = k;
                    }
                }
                
                if ((grid[idxs[0]][0] && grid[idxs[1]][1] && grid[idxs[2]][2]) ||
                    (grid[idxs[0]][0] && grid[idxs[2]][1] && grid[idxs[1]][2]) ||
                    (grid[idxs[1]][0] && grid[idxs[0]][1] && grid[idxs[2]][2]) ||
                    (grid[idxs[1]][0] && grid[idxs[2]][1] && grid[idxs[0]][2]) ||
                    (grid[idxs[2]][0] && grid[idxs[0]][1] && grid[idxs[1]][2]) ||
                    (grid[idxs[2]][0] && grid[idxs[1]][1] && grid[idxs[0]][2])) {
                    comb_mask |= 1 << i;
                }
            }
            
            f[comb_mask] = (f[comb_mask] + prod) % MOD;
        }
        
        // Second part: columns 3-5
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); ++mask) {
            boolean[][] grid = new boolean[6][6];
            long prod = 1;
            int idx = 0;
            
            for (int r = 0; r < 6; ++r) {
                for (int c = 3; c <= 5; ++c) {
                    if ((mask >> idx & 1) == 1) {
                        grid[r][c] = true;
                        prod = prod * p[r][c] % MOD;
                    } else {
                        prod = prod * ((1 - p[r][c] + MOD) % MOD) % MOD;
                    }
                    ++idx;
                }
            }
            
            int comb_mask = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < tri.size(); ++i) {
                int combo = tri.get(i);
                int comp = combo ^ 63;
                int[] idxs = new int[3];
                int cnt = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) {
                    if ((comp >> k & 1) == 1) {
                        idxs[cnt++] = k;
                    }
                }
                
                if ((grid[idxs[0]][3] && grid[idxs[1]][4] && grid[idxs[2]][5]) ||
                    (grid[idxs[0]][3] && grid[idxs[2]][4] && grid[idxs[1]][5]) ||
                    (grid[idxs[1]][3] && grid[idxs[0]][4] && grid[idxs[2]][5]) ||
                    (grid[idxs[1]][3] && grid[idxs[2]][4] && grid[idxs[0]][5]) ||
                    (grid[idxs[2]][3] && grid[idxs[0]][4] && grid[idxs[1]][5]) ||
                    (grid[idxs[2]][3] && grid[idxs[1]][4] && grid[idxs[0]][5])) {
                    comb_mask |= 1 << i;
                }
            }
            
            g[comb_mask] = (g[comb_mask] + prod) % MOD;
        }
        
        // SOS DP
        for (int b = 0; b < 20; ++b) {
            for (int m = (1 << 20) - 1; m >= 0; --m) {
                if ((m >> b & 1) == 1) {
                    g[m] = (g[m] + g[m ^ (1 << b)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        
        long ans = 0;
        for (int m = 0; m < (1 << 20); ++m) {
            ans = (ans + f[m] * g[((1 << 20) - 1) ^ m]) % MOD;
        }
        
        System.out.println((1 - ans + MOD) % MOD);
    }
}
